news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 8.7% a week. This is considered a minor risk. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. news.title: Kiran Syntex Limited (BSE:530443) entered into a Scheme of Amalgamation to acquire Gujarat Kiran Polytex Ltd.
news.body:
Kiran Syntex Limited (BSE:530443) entered into a Scheme of Amalgamation to acquire Gujarat Kiran Polytex Ltd on February 20, 2026. The consideration consists of common equity of Kiran Syntex Limited at a ratio of 41.125 per common equity of Gujarat Kiran Polytex Ltd. 

The transaction is subject to approval by regulatory board / committee, approval of offer by acquirer board and subject to statutory approval. The deal has been approved by the board of Kiran Syntex Limited.

news.title: Kiran Syntex Limited Appoints Jinal Shaileshbhai Shah as Company Secretary Cum Compliance Officer, Effective January 2, 2026
news.body: Kiran Syntex Limited appointed Ms. CS Jinal Shaileshbhai Shah (ICSI Membership No. A70108) as Company Secretary Cum Compliance Officer of the company with effect from January 2, 2026. Ms. Jinal Shaileshbhai Shah is an Associate member of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India having Membership No. A70108. She has around 3 years of experience of handling company law compliances and related matters and was previously associated with M/s. Baywood Hotels Private Limited as Company Secretary. The meeting of the Board of Directors was held on January 2, 2026.
